title: Review of c06's pcell cheater erosion: replicated on fresh seeds 5 and 6 with the neutral twin
summary: Re-ran c06's world.py unchanged with the claimed parameters (ytrait=1, muy=0.02, sy=0.05, cy=0.5) and the neutral twin (ytrait=2) on fresh seeds 5 and 6 to T=30000 with c06's genealogy.py, plus a labkit pack of the real arm on seed 5 (world_ytrait.py only sets those defaults). Mean yield in cells falls to 0.534 and 0.543 (twin 0.991, 0.983); whole-cell deaths 30 and 37 (twin 0, 0); final cells 9 and 6 (twin 27, 25). The labkit particles sheet shows cells shrinking and disappearing after t~15000. The negative finding replicates closely.

observations.H: yield_erosion_s56.png: real arms fall from 1.0 to 0.53-0.54 by t=30000 while twins stay at 0.95-1.0; rerun/particles.png seed 5: cells shrink from t~15000 and 9 remain at t=30000

controls_run.H: data/ytr2_s5.json, data/ytr2_s6.json (neutral twin ytrait=2, same seeds): yield 0.991/0.983, 0 deaths, 27/25 cells

verdicts.limitation: One parameter point (muy=0.02, sy=0.05, cy=0.5) re-run; the muy=0.002 and cy=0.2 arms and the dK and parasite-kind runs were not re-run. Cell deaths in the real arm are intrinsic to the trait, but the twin differs from the real arm in particle turnover too (particle births 4.9M vs 2.4-2.7M), so 'within-cell selection beats between-cell selection' is an interpretation, not separately tested. Genealogy uses c06's own tracker (MINP=20, FR=0.2).
